runtime.inert: plugin-source repo — plugins execute inside Claude Code sessions; there is no app process to boot. The executed verification leg is the test suite plus the workflow codegen drift check.

routing.doctrine: spec/commands/*.md, spec/doctrine/*.md, spec/agents/*.md, spec/templates/*, git/commands/*.md, spec/hooks/hooks.json, plugin manifests
routing.scripts: spec/scripts/*.js|*.sh, spec/bin/*, scripts/*, autopilot daemon source (routes here until it earns its own kind)
routing.workflows: spec/workflows/src/*.body.js, spec/workflows/fragments/*.frag — generated wf-*.js is NEVER a File Plan row
